title: Mask Adoption Behavior Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population under social influence, perceived risk, policy interventions, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among network neighbors and update beliefs and adoption probability based on social exposure.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Government or workplaces mandate and enforce mask use; individuals may comply based on propensity and enforcement intensity.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to purchase masks; success depends on retailer inventory, price, and individual income/access.

interactions.name: campaign_exposure
interactions.description: Government and media broadcast messages that affect risk perception, attitudes, and trust, influencing adoption.

interactions.name: location_observation
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use and enforcement at workplaces/schools and internalize norms.

interactions.name: supply_price_feedback
interactions.description: Retailers adjust price based on inventory and demand; price affects individuals' ability and willingness to adopt.

interactions.name: environmental_risk_feedback
interactions.description: Changes in environmental risk (e.g., reported cases) influence individuals’ risk perception and adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals using masks at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate at the end of the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_70
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption reaches 70% of the population, if reached.

metrics.name: mandate_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals complying with mask mandates during mandate periods.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference or ratio of adoption rates between subgroups (e.g., by income or age).

metrics.name: shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days with retailer inventory below a defined threshold (e.g., <5% of demand).

metrics.name: average_price_paid
metrics.description: Mean price paid per mask by individuals over the simulation.

metrics.name: campaign_cost_per_adopter
metrics.description: Campaign spending divided by the incremental number of adopters attributable to the campaign.

metrics.name: cascade_size_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of sizes of social adoption cascades initiated by seed adopters or campaign exposures.
